task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Grab the compact glossy blue toycar with the left arm and place on the black smooth stand.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架，用左臂抓住紧凑的亮蓝色玩具车，并将其放置在黑色光滑的支架上。
